name: Wedl Alm
kurzbeschreibung: Bar in the district of Landeck in Tyrol – according to the entry, with creative cocktails and a relaxed atmosphere.
beschreibung: The Wedl Alm is listed as a bar in the Landeck region of Tyrol in the present entry. In this holiday region, Tyrolean gastronomy is represented by a mix of traditional huts and modern establishments. According to the entry, guests can expect a relaxed atmosphere with creative cocktails; the offering stands for enjoyment and sociability, and the price range is mid-level. The Landeck region comprises the valley basin around the town of Landeck as well as the Paznaun and Kaunertal valleys and is one of the popular holiday destinations of the Tyrolean Alps.
